hero.title: A Canadian virtual number for SMS verification
intro: Canada shares the +1 country code with the United States, which gives its numbers a quiet superpower: in most sign-up flows they're treated exactly like American ones. You get a number from the North American numbering plan — the format every major service knows by heart — with a Canadian identity behind it.

SMS Code gives you a real Canadian mobile number in one tap. Enter it at the verification step, and the SMS — with a code from Google, Discord, Tinder, Snapchat or Apple — arrives in the app usually within seconds.

whyCountry.title: Why choose a Canadian number?
body: Because Canada lives inside the same +1 numbering plan as the US, services rarely distinguish between the two at verification — a Canadian number passes wherever a North American number is expected. That makes it a strong alternative when you want the +1 format but a fresh pool of numbers to draw from.

It's also the right choice when the account should genuinely be Canadian: a Canadian Apple ID or Google profile, a Tinder presence in a Canadian city, an account tied to the Canadian market rather than the American one. Same trusted format, different country behind it.

tips.title: One code, two countries
tips.body: Canada and the US share +1, and the number itself doesn't announce which country it belongs to — the area code decides. In practice, services that accept a US number accept a Canadian one in the very same field.

tips.title: A fresh pool for +1 sign-ups
tips.body: US numbers see heavy verification traffic. If a service is being difficult with one +1 number, a Canadian number gives you the same familiar format from a different, often less-trafficked pool.

tips.title: Anchor Canadian accounts properly
tips.body: Building a genuinely Canadian account — say, a Canadian App Store profile? Pair the number with the matching store region and settings so the whole account tells one consistent story.

faqs.q: Is it a real Canadian mobile number?
faqs.a: Yes — a number on a real carrier network within the North American +1 plan, held by a Canadian area code. Services see a standard North American mobile number.

faqs.q: Will services treat it like a US number?
faqs.a: In most flows, yes — both countries share +1, and few services distinguish between them at the verification step. Where a service does check region, the Canadian area code marks it as Canadian.

faqs.q: Which services work well with a Canadian number?
faqs.a: Anything built for the North American market: Google, Discord, Tinder, Snapchat, Apple. Their sign-up flows are designed around +1 numbers, and a Canadian one fits natively.

faqs.q: Can I use a Canadian number from outside Canada?
faqs.a: Yes. The number lives in the SMS Code app, not in a SIM card, so you receive the verification SMS wherever you are in the world.

faqs.q: How long do I have the number?
faqs.a: For the activation window — enough time to receive the verification code. If the SMS never arrives, cancel the activation at no charge; if you keep the account, secure it with a recovery email and app-based 2FA.
